description: This file defines a Qwik component for a notes application front-end, managing notes list, note viewing/editing, and user interactions such as search, create, delete, and save.

methods.name: loadNotes$
methods.description: Asynchronously loads notes based on current token and search query, updates active note accordingly.

methods.name: onSelect$
methods.description: Handler for selecting a note from the list, updates active note id.

methods.name: onSave$
methods.description: Handler for saving a note, either updates existing or creates a new note, then reloads notes.

methods.name: onDelete$
methods.description: Handler for deleting the active note, clears active note state and reloads notes.

methods.name: onNew$
methods.description: Resets active note to create a new note.

methods.name: onSearch$
methods.description: Performs search based on current query and reloads notes.
